title: Latency and timeouts on compute-svc

detection.alert: compute-svc: p99 latency > 2 s for 5 min

impact: Requests slowed down and a share of them timed out on compute-svc
symptom: [ANOMALY] compute-svc 2026-04-25 19:53-20:13: compute-svc: 19 of 26 log lines were non-INFO between 2026-04-25 19:53 and 2026-04-25 20:13 UTC (peak error ratio 0.79 vs baseline median 0.0). 2 error templates, 1 first seen in this span.
error_templates: Retrying connect to server: resourcemanager:8030. Already tried <*> time(s)

_templates.macro: Deploy {version_to} of compute-svc removed exponential backoff from ResourceManager calls; combined with retry.max raised earlier it created a retry storm.
_templates.micro: {file}:{line} ({symbol}) replaces exponential backoff with a constant BASE_BACKOFF_MS.
_templates.remediation: Roll back compute-svc {version_to} -> {version_from}; restore `backoffMs = Math.min(backoffMs * 2, MAX_BACKOFF_MS)` at {file}:{line}; revert retry.max to its previous value.

rca.macro: Deploy v2.10.0 of compute-svc removed exponential backoff from ResourceManager calls; combined with retry.max raised earlier it created a retry storm.
rca.micro: compute/rpc/RMClient.java:308 (RMClient.allocate) replaces exponential backoff with a constant BASE_BACKOFF_MS.
rca.remediation: Roll back compute-svc v2.10.0 -> v2.9.0; restore `backoffMs = Math.min(backoffMs * 2, MAX_BACKOFF_MS)` at compute/rpc/RMClient.java:308; revert retry.max to its previous value.

action_items: Add a regression test covering RMClient.allocate (compute/rpc/RMClient.java).
Alert on the error signature `Retrying connect to server: resourcemanager:8030. Already tried <*> time(s)`.
